fact: CITADEL presented at LoResLM 2026 a French-Mooré speech translation system (150 hours of audio, 4.24% error) already used by the government on Burkina-en-marche.gov.bf, and a text translation model fine-tuned on 83,000 validated sentence pairs.
title: Intelligence artificielle : le Centre d’Excellence Interdisciplinaire en Intelligence Artificielle pour le Développement (CITADEL) au cours du LoResLM 2026 : l’IA burkinabè parle désormais en Mooré
